candidates.change_summary: Change acc.balance += msg.value to acc.balance = msg.value so balance is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Remove the require overflow check so malicious large msg.value can cause overflow, changing balance.
Change unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring _unlockTime, so Put affects future Collect differently.
Replace acc.unlockTime = ... with acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime, so unlockTime can be set in the past, changing collectability.
Delete the unlockTime assignment so unlockTime remains zero, allowing immediate collection after Put.
Delete the require-like condition that checks acc.balance >= MinSum && acc.balance >= _am, so Collect can be called with larger amounts than balance.
Replace the subtraction `acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am)` with `acc.balance = acc.balance` so that balance is not reduced after a successful Collect.
Delete the unlock-time check `block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime` from the if-condition, allowing collection before the unlock time.
Replace the condition `acc.balance >= MinSum` with `true` so that any positive balance satisfies the MinSum requirement.
Delete the entire if-body block (including balance update and ether transfer), so Collect becomes a no-op and never changes balance.
Replace `acc.balance = (acc.balance - _am)` with `acc.balance = (acc.balance + _am)` so that Collect increases the balance instead of decreasing it.
